idle.markup:
Menu Component

A panel-styled list of focusable rows for dropdown menus, command palettes, and contextual actions. Items can carry icons (start or end), keyboard-shortcut hints, and chevrons for multi-level menus. Groups are visually divided and may have an optional header. A direct text node or single unclassified element fills the label column; use .menu__label only to group multiple label nodes. RTL flips the layout automatically.

Inline

All variants together. Tab through the menu — only items receive focus; group headers and separators are skipped. Hover and :focus-visible produce the same highlight.

More actions

Dropdown (native popover)

Uses the native HTML Popover API plus CSS anchor positioning — no JavaScript. Click the trigger to open; press Esc or click outside to dismiss.

Share

Preferred direction

Add one of the directional modifier classes to a popover-mode menu to change the side it opens on. Each modifier auto-flips to the opposite side(s) when the requested direction would overflow the viewport, so you only have to declare a preference — the browser handles edges. 

<div class="menu" popover>…</div>                  // default: drop down
<div class="menu -block-start" popover>…</div>     // drop up
<div class="menu -inline-end" popover>…</div>      // open right
<div class="menu -inline-start" popover>…</div>    // open left

RTL

Same markup, wrapped in dir="rtl". Start icons move to the right edge, the shortcut hint sits on the start (left) edge, and the chevron flips so the arrow always points toward the inline-end.

المزيد

tokens.--color-accent-active: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) calc(l + 0.28) c calc(h - 18)) calc(l - 0.16) calc(c * 0.78) h)
tokens.--color-accent-hover: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) calc(l + 0.28) c calc(h - 18)) calc(l + 0.02) calc(c * 0.85) h)
tokens.--color-border-disabled: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l - 0.13) c h) calc(l + 0.06) c h)
tokens.--color-error-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(70% 0.3 15) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.25)
tokens.--color-info-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(88% 0.15 202) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.30)
tokens.--color-shadow-surface-base: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.75) c h) l calc(0.2 * 0.05) 245)
tokens.--color-success-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(88% 0.25 148) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.25)
tokens.--color-surface-active: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.1) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-disabled: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.2) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-hover: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.05) c h)
tokens.--color-surface-secondary: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l - 0.03) c h)
tokens.--color-warning-soft: oklch(from oklch(from oklch(70% 0.2 43) 0.68 calc(c * 0.82) h) l c h / 0.30)
tokens.--inset-shadow-highlight: inset 0 1px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.75) c h) l calc(0.2 * 0.05) 245) l c h / 0.6)
tokens.--inset-shadow-highlight-pressed: inset 0 1px oklch(from oklch(calc(38 * 1%) 0.2 245) l c h / 0.15)
tokens.--inset-shadow-pressed: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.1)
tokens.--shadow-drop: 0 1px 2px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.2)
tokens.--shadow-drop-subtle: 0 1px 1px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c calc(h * 0.9 + 245 * 0.1)) l c h / 0.1)
tokens.--text-shadow-debossed: 0 -1px oklch(from oklch(25% 0.02 200) l c h / 0.2), 0 1px oklch(from oklch(from oklch(90% 0.02 200) calc(l + 0.08) calc(0.02 * 0.25) h) calc(l + 0.1) c h / 0.8)
